description: Land Title Settlement Department - Wewathenna, Kandy Four Gravets and Gangawata Koralaya D/S Division, Kandy District - Cad. Map No. 320385
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, and legal status of land titles. The content focuses on land registration, property ownership determinations, and cadastral information, which falls squarely within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land and property-related administrative matters.
